@graph.description: Compare Help Scout Free, Standard, Plus and Pro prices, user limits, inbox counts, Docs sites and Envoy costs before you choose a support plan in 2026.

itemListElement.name: Help Scout Pricing: Plans and AI Costs

mainEntity.name: Does Help Scout have a free plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The Free plan lists up to five users, one inbox, one Docs site and 100 contacts per month. It has smaller article, tag and saved-reply allowances than paid plans.

mainEntity.name: How much does Help Scout Standard cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The pricing page displayed Standard at US$25 per user/month on November 11, 2026. The page has a monthly and annual selector, so confirm the selected billing mode and currency before purchase.
The public pricing page displays Envoy at US$0.75 per resolution. Confirm the current definition of a resolution and estimate volume before enabling it across all support channels.

mainEntity.name: Does Help Scout charge for extra inboxes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The pricing page lists an additional inbox at US$10 per month on paid plans. Billing mode and current terms can affect the final amount.
